project_type: Next.js 16 (React 19) static-export marketing/admin site with AWS Amplify backend; package wecare-digital-admin-platform, "type":"module", next output:'export'
build_system: npm scripts. build = node scripts/generate-public-pages.js && next build && ...; this task only needs typecheck/lint/test, not a full next build.
test_framework: vitest run (jsdom + @testing-library/react). Single suite for this task: src/test/VayuLokLive.test.tsx. Tests stub window.google.maps (FakeMap/FakeMarker/FakeGeocoder/FakeImageMapType/overlayMapTypes) and global fetch.
build_command: npm run typecheck && npm run lint
test_command: npx vitest run src/test/VayuLokLive.test.tsx   (full suite: npm run test)
verification_instructions: 1) install deps incl. deck.gl packages (@deck.gl/core, @deck.gl/layers, @deck.gl/google-maps and their luma peer if required). 2) npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit) must pass. 3) npm run lint (eslint .) must pass. 4) npx vitest run src/test/VayuLokLive.test.tsx must pass; then npm run test for the whole suite. The live Google map/overlay/air calls CANNOT run in sandbox because the browser key is referrer-restricted to *.wecare.digital/* - a blank/absent map is EXPECTED, not a failure. Verify behavior via stubbed-google tests + honest-degradation, never by expecting a live map or by faking data.
snapshot_or_generated_files: none for this task. package.json + package-lock.json WILL change when deck.gl is added - that is expected and in-scope.
setup_instructions: npm install (Node v22.23.3 in sandbox works; .nvmrc pins 24). Then npm install the deck.gl packages. No amplify install needed for this task.
environment_constraints: Network restricted (no live Google calls; npm registry access needed only to add deck.gl - if the registry is unreachable, that is a blocker for the dependency step, flag it). Google browser key referrer-restricted to *.wecare.digital/* so map/Places/geocoding/AirQuality do not run in sandbox. No new Google credential may be provisioned (owner action) -> client-side sampling only (see RESEARCH doc).
contribution_requirements: Steering 00-current-owner-overrides.md + 01-standing-authorization.md: run unattended, do NOT push or open/merge PRs (orchestrator publishes). No red anywhere on the page. Google logo/.gm-style-cc legal + Place Photo author attributions must stay visible; no CSS targeting .gm-style-cc / a[href*=google] / img[alt=Google]. Maps key read ONLY from process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_KEY, never hardcoded. Keep JSX inline (styled-jsx only scopes statically-visible markup).
key_patterns: styled-jsx scoped under .vl-live-. Design tokens on .vl-live: --paper #fff, --ground #fafafa, --lime #d1f470, --lime-tint rgba(209,244,112,.22), --green #1a3a2a, no-red AQI ramp --aqi-good #1a3a2a / --aqi-sat #3da35a / --aqi-mod #d1f470 / --aqi-poor #e8c547 / --aqi-worst #c98a2e, --r-panel 14px, --r-pill 999px. Existing reusable helpers: airPointFromApi (parses a currentConditions row to {time,aqi,word,pm25}), aqiCategory, statusWord, metaFromGooglePlace, PLACE_META_FIELDS, dotClass. Google libs loaded via importLibrary('maps'|'marker'|'places'|'geocoding'); Geocoder from geocoding lib with legacy fallback (ALREADY FIXED - keep). Air fetched via POST airquality.googleapis.com/v1/currentConditions:lookup with the browser key.
directory_structure: src/components/VayuLokLive.tsx (~2891 lines, the whole live page; self-styled). src/test/VayuLokLive.test.tsx (~1002 lines, vitest). src/pages/vayulok/index.tsx is the rotating-word hero - UNCHANGED. amplify/ is the backend (NOT touched this pass).
